prompt: Create a creative minimalist 3D scrapbook composition featuring a realistic photograph transformed into a thick, floating paper cutout on a warm ivory textured background. For the first scene, showcase a beautiful sunlit modern bedroom with an olive-green bed, walnut furniture, large windows, lush indoor plants, a round mirror, and soft natural sunlight. For the second scene, depict dramatic white coastal cliffs covered in vibrant green grass, deep blue ocean waves, and a striking red-and-white lighthouse beneath a cloudy sky. Make the photograph appear as a curved, folded sheet of thick paper with realistic depth, visible layered edges, soft shadows, and a floating effect. Add tiny hand-drawn black stick-figure characters interacting with the paper, pushing, lifting, or holding its edges, alongside playful handwritten captions such as "Another version of my room" and "Same place, different layer. Elegant editorial photography, realistic textures, subtle imperfections, minimalist art direction, soft beige palette, creative visual storytelling, premium design magazine aesthetic, crisp details, balanced composition, vertical poster layout.

promptZh: 创建一个富有创意的极简主义 3D 剪贴簿构图，将一张逼真的照片转化为温暖象牙色纹理背景上厚实、悬浮的纸片剪影。第一个场景展示一间阳光充足的现代卧室，配有橄榄绿床铺、胡桃木家具、大窗户、茂盛的室内植物、圆形镜子以及柔和的自然光。第二个场景描绘戏剧性的白色海岸悬崖，覆盖着生机勃勃的绿草，深蓝色的海浪，以及多云天空下一座醒目的红白相间灯塔。使照片呈现为弯曲、折叠的厚纸片效果，具有逼真的深度、可见的分层边缘、柔和阴影和悬浮感。添加微小的手绘黑色火柴人角色与纸片互动，如推、举或抓住其边缘，并配上俏皮的手写标题，例如“我房间的另一个版本”和“同一个地方，不同的层次。”。优雅编辑摄影风格，逼真纹理，细微瑕疵，极简艺术指导，柔和米色调色板，创意视觉叙事，高端设计杂志美学，清晰细节，平衡构图，垂直海报布局。
